answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in falcon, checked in atlas, and echo reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1323 identities would post 4419 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
